name: The Thing in the Tavern
description: Sealed in the cellar by Archmage Hann. It promises treasure for its freedom but has none; whoever frees it gets only a head start and a cruel smile.

name: The Ivy on the Well
description: Creeping ivy smothering the well head.

name: Porcelain Soldiers (1d6)
description: The sentries on the wall and gatehouse.

name: Forest Goblins (2d6)
description: Camped in the ruined village by the bridge, in a drunken revel and contest.

name: The Shadow in the Forest
description: A great shadow has lain over the Forest of Dawn since ancient times. Human and animal sacrifice once held it back; the temple's faith made it dormant. The spheres on their pedestals are what still hold it, and each one taken weakens the ward.
